retraction.reason: Retracted in M44b, class A: the neighbour is missing, and it is the same missing neighbour as the Philippine revolution’s. The treaty settles a war this atlas does not hold. Its Portuguese bearing would run through the Anglo-German convention of August 1898 on the partition of the Portuguese colonies, which is what the treaty of Windsor of 1899 already here was the answer to; without the convention there is nothing between the two but a date. Naming that link without a source this atlas holds would be exactly the confident sentence the brief forbids.
